## Key Technical Features
1. **Summed-Area Table Adaptive Shadow Removal**: Converts unevenly lit / dim-shadow camera photos of handwritten signatures on paper into 100% pure `Alpha=0` transparent PNGs with black/blue/red ink enhancement.
2. **Compliant Seal Geometries**: Circular, Oval, and Traditional 2x2 Right-to-Left Legal Square seal layouts with realistic vermilion sponge ink micro-grain. Strictly for authorized self-entity testing and internal workflow use.
3. **Perforation Seal (骑缝章) Auto-Slicer & Offline PDF 1.4 Generator**: Divides a seal across `N` contract pages with pixel-exact right-edge coordinates and exports multi-page PDFs 100% offline.
